subject: expression: refactor functions to build expressions (#50997)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent, focusing on `pkg/expression`, `pkg/planner/*`, `pkg/executor/*`, `pkg/table/*`. The change is a refactor/renaming that separates “simple” AST build/eval (`expression.BuildSimpleExpr` / `expression.EvalSimpleAst`) from planner-context build/eval (`planner/util.{RewriteAstExprWithPlanCtx,EvalAstExprWithPlanCtx}`), and updates call sites accordingly; the underlying implementation remains the same `expressionRewriter` with planCtx-required nodes still rejected in “simple” mode. Partition-related code now uses `ParseSimpleExpr` and adds a `PlanID.Add(1)` shim to preserve historical plan-id increments (EXPLAIN/test output only). Checked later history up to `upstream/master` for the touched files and didn’t find follow-up fixes suggesting a correctness regression.
